source: Attribute names whose values are text, on top of those whose last word is {0}, {1}, {2}, {3}, {4}, {5}, {6}, {7} and the like. Markup attributes outside this set are never extracted.
text: Attributnamen, deren Werte Text sind, zusätzlich zu denen, deren letztes Wort {0}, {1}, {2}, {3}, {4}, {5}, {6}, {7} und dergleichen ist. Markup-Attribute außerhalb dieser Menge werden nie extrahiert.
